title: Treaty of Versailles
summary: Signed on 28 June 1919, five years to the day after Sarajevo, the treaty ended the state of war between Germany and most of the Allies. Germany lost Alsace-Lorraine, the Polish corridor, its colonies and its fleet, was limited to an army of a hundred thousand, was held responsible with its allies for the loss and damage of the war under article 231, and was left owing reparations whose amount a commission would fix later. It was accepted under protest and denounced in Germany as a dictated peace for the whole of the Weimar Republic's life. What weight it carries in the origins of the next war is one of the longest-running arguments in modern history, and the atlas keeps it open.

actors.note: signed by the state that had replaced the German Empire eleven days into its own existence: Q41304 gives the Weimar Republic an inception of 1918-11-09
